extraction.notes: Reconciliation taken from the seq 11 page (printed as 7); the same FFO table is repeated on seq 16 (printed S-3). Starting line is Net income available to common stockholders (not total net income). Company reports only FFO and Core FFO; no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null/empty. Share count printed as 66,674,655 and divided by 1,000 to match thousands units; 268,673/66,674.655 = 4.03 and 264,506/66,674.655 = 3.97, matching reported per-share figures. Zero-valued lines (impairment from unconsolidated co-investments, loss on early retirement of debt, co-investment promote income) are shown as 0 for Q3 2025. Depreciation attributable to third party ownership and other (-38) was classified as re_depreciation. Provision for credit losses, co-investment-related and G&A/other lines were classified as 'other'. Recurring capex: no AFFO and no capex figure in these pages, so null. Verified: FFO and Core FFO subtotals foot.
